
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/ifmeme/p/19342280" title="发布于 2025-12-12 16:50">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">利用Apipost AI自动生成接口测试用例并批量执行</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>不少测试人员想了解，有没有不需要通过写代码，让AI快速生成接口测试用例和测试数据，并能够快速执行的方式？当下几个比较常用的接口测试工具，Apipost即具有这个能力，而且操作起来还很方便，完全是预期的功能效果，今天就给大家分享一下如何去实现。</h2>
<h2><strong>一、自动生成接口测试用例</strong></h2>
<h2><strong>1、操作入口</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>进入Apipost，先将你要进行测试的接口导进来（很多种导入方式，如：导入cURL、导入接口文档让Ai自动识别等方式都可以）</li>
<li>点击你要测试的接口，在主界面选择接口用例-AI数据池</li>
<li>选择要进行生成用例的维度（就是需要验证哪些东西，如果不太清楚，可以全部勾选，看看效果先）</li>
</ul>
<img data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1233" data-rawheight="875" data-watermark="original" data-original-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-fb9c38907794821802eaa1977cadf288~resize:0:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532029-0-0-5b5101755ea09bce7c7a6978aa5e8cac&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532029&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-watermark-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-4280b4f4e481840f05f034d9c0857284~resize:1440:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532029-0-0-d1b0fd8f4555d209d69d2782c636757b&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532029&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-private-watermark-src="" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-fb9c38907794821802eaa1977cadf288~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765529419-0-0-c412e093567c9fddb491829f9dfd0463&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1765529419&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=720052902642129b1b31d1be9469c826&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload">
<h2><strong>2、AI生成的接口用例效果</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><br>在上一步执行生成用例之后，就会自动生成各种维度的接口测试用例了</li>
<li><br>每个维度都生成了多条正向、反向接口用例，包含测试目的、期望结果和多组测试数据，建议可以检查一下，如果有不需要的可以进行删除或调整</li>

</ul>

<img data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1036" data-rawheight="900" data-watermark="original" data-original-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-2e6bd6f89864c51b82147416f58f6fdd~resize:0:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532029-0-0-3501e62e19eb3c6dc672664123675ea5&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532029&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-watermark-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-59366c5374b20bf61f10a16c21c8d2fd~resize:1440:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532029-0-0-ffa49ceb7eed110df123b39123d25476&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532029&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-private-watermark-src="" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-2e6bd6f89864c51b82147416f58f6fdd~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765529419-0-0-aa6df8c501d8556d504e0778aec6fd86&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1765529419&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=720052902642129b1b31d1be9469c826&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload">
<h3><strong>生成的部分测试数据</strong></h3>

<img data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1089" data-rawheight="900" data-watermark="original" data-original-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-df858053d1d1e4889903c5ab437f0cea~resize:0:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532029-0-0-e2ee9105019740100b39b87a65abe0ad&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532029&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-watermark-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-ca23e0e76f3cf2831ba06f0810209fb5~resize:1440:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532029-0-0-ac355fba9a3a7362d6a50759e68c5545&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532029&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-private-watermark-src="" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-df858053d1d1e4889903c5ab437f0cea~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765529419-0-0-33ad4dc5905bcdcd7f49998be4602bc1&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1765529419&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=720052902642129b1b31d1be9469c826&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload">
<h3><strong>生成多个维度的用例</strong></h3>

<img data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="996" data-rawheight="903" data-watermark="original" data-original-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-fa556ffe48786f115eaa6f19755c771d~resize:0:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532029-0-0-ad7e5746595fe4321e2406ea3c1251da&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532029&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-watermark-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-7b13ede18dbed2fcd583bde50df7229e~resize:1440:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532029-0-0-9284cf3d5cf379e646292344ba2c2db2&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532029&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-private-watermark-src="" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-fa556ffe48786f115eaa6f19755c771d~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765529419-0-0-ad6814a2bc5e995843ebf534f4635eb6&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1765529419&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=720052902642129b1b31d1be9469c826&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload">
<h2><strong>二、执行批量接口测试用例</strong></h2>
<p>前面把接口用例生成完成之后，我们需要进行执行测试这些用例，验证接口是否符合预期，</p>
<p>当然，apipost也提供了快速对多条用例进行测试的功能，操作如下：</p>

<img data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1157" data-rawheight="971" data-watermark="original" data-original-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-fde9de029cec8b2913428d5ab896ecb6~resize:0:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532030-0-0-4401dffdc6596f365a76bba73750e1c4&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532030&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-watermark-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-cd661f9fa398bf1b42fa342c4189d381~resize:1440:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532030-0-0-e2c211804b802b5fe6eed60376c094c9&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532030&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-private-watermark-src="" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-fde9de029cec8b2913428d5ab896ecb6~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765529419-0-0-bffc28ea47d818f1bf328e1485be1941&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1765529419&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=720052902642129b1b31d1be9469c826&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload">
<p>点击**<code>应用</code>**：点击后保存测试用例到AI数据池中，并关闭当前界面。</p>
<p>点击**<code>应用并测试</code>**：点击后执行 <code>应用</code> 操作并开始进行接口用例测试，进入<strong>「</strong>执行测试用例界面」。</p>
<h3><strong>1、执行测试用例</strong></h3>
<p>进入执行测试用例界面，显示执行进度和执行的用例总数等信息，这里可能需要等一下（特别是用例比较多的情况，不过也蛮快的）</p>

<img data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1080" data-rawheight="949" data-watermark="original" data-original-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-3bfdc81793a04ecf110e186dfa3d385b~resize:0:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532030-0-0-2a2c4f0eb0067b2e39cc07779dc1d6cb&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532030&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-watermark-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-cd5e0f75548609a648973164f862a535~resize:1440:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532030-0-0-ed9a4b09874f6bc101734d391b7d2394&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532030&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-private-watermark-src="" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-3bfdc81793a04ecf110e186dfa3d385b~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765529419-0-0-fcff28972b91969a8d05dfe2a38b1c8d&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1765529419&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=720052902642129b1b31d1be9469c826&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload">
<h3><strong>2、查看执行详情</strong></h3>
<p>每一条测试数据右侧会有一个 <code>查看执行详情</code> 按钮，点击后将打开二级抽屉「用例执行详情」，</p>
<p>展示包括测试结果、日志信息等。</p>
<p>可以在此页面进行编辑接口相关数据，进行 <code>简单调试</code> ，重新执行测试，快速定位问题等操作</p>

<img data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1080" data-rawheight="955" data-watermark="original" data-original-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-6e690ae7aa7c22702b4e9426cf328f77~resize:0:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532030-0-0-86c665e590bc3812a4ab25dbe693366d&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532030&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-watermark-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-5e85582543754a98037cce2584993cf1~resize:1440:q75.jpg?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765532030-0-0-e4501cf0f19ae17b77d3478197cf4639&amp;draft_token=1982810935736435955&amp;expiration=1765532030&amp;incremental=false&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;source=ccfced1a" data-private-watermark-src="" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-6e690ae7aa7c22702b4e9426cf328f77~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765529419-0-0-a6e0d5527ecedceaeff2bc94ff069390&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1765529419&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=720052902642129b1b31d1be9469c826&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload">
<h2><strong>生成测试报告</strong></h2>
<p>当所有用例都执行完成之后，页面中将显示<strong>“AI生成报告”</strong> 按钮，点击后，AI将根据当前的执行信息，自动生成该次测试的详细测试报告结果</p>

<img data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1080" data-rawheight="960" data-watermark="original" data-original-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-f69c6163e0401b9a6bc1713f0715b666~resize:0:q75.png?source=1f5c5e47&amp;expiration=1765532066&amp;auth_key=1765532066-0-0-73bea8ac07b536ac291353e60bac9fb9&amp;protocol=v2&amp;sampling=False&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;overTime=60&amp;incremental=False&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;animatedImageAutoPlay=False&amp;retryCount=3&amp;precoder=False" data-watermark-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-f14b36a4a3e5bf82b7eef449ca420156~resize:1440:q75.png?source=1f5c5e47&amp;expiration=1765532066&amp;auth_key=1765532066-0-0-13a55dd3d8f2d7f4e8273cec782dadb2&amp;protocol=v2&amp;sampling=False&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;overTime=60&amp;incremental=False&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;animatedImageAutoPlay=False&amp;retryCount=3&amp;precoder=False" data-private-watermark-src="" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-f69c6163e0401b9a6bc1713f0715b666~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765529419-0-0-d430c16d62ef253686a9c4525a546b2f&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1765529419&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=720052902642129b1b31d1be9469c826&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload">
<p>测试报告内容包括：</p>
<p><strong>测试概况</strong>：测试开始和结束时间、执行的测试用例数量等。</p>
<p><strong>用例结果分析</strong>：每个测试用例的执行结果，以及智能分析结果。</p>
<p><strong>测试结论</strong>：根据测试用例最终生成测试结论。</p>
<p>测试报告生成完成后，将自动被保存在 <strong><code>接口用例-测试报告</code></strong> 列表中，您可以随时查看或下载以供后续分析</p>
<h2><strong>三、将用例保存至AI用例池</strong></h2>
<p>apipost还支持把AI生成的用例数据都将存储在「AI用例数据池」中，方便下次进行复用等；</p>
<p>勾选对应的接口用例，可以通过 同步数据至常规数据池 功能将AI数据同步到常规数据池中，</p>
<p>进行批量执行或在自动化测试中进行引用执行。</p>

<img data-caption="" data-size="normal" data-rawwidth="1080" data-rawheight="986" data-watermark="original" data-original-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-0adb59dc6af764118475322efc82fee8~resize:0:q75.png?source=1f5c5e47&amp;expiration=1765532549&amp;auth_key=1765532549-0-0-356d4b797c8fb3a1b9679a160c5689cf&amp;protocol=v2&amp;sampling=False&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;overTime=60&amp;incremental=False&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;animatedImageAutoPlay=False&amp;retryCount=3&amp;precoder=False" data-watermark-src="https://pic-private.zhihu.com/v2-0f9e13979874272f0d15164f59a904dc~resize:1440:q75.png?source=1f5c5e47&amp;expiration=1765532549&amp;auth_key=1765532549-0-0-3f4f2950d0f10ebb7c6761e6d3f08834&amp;protocol=v2&amp;sampling=False&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;overTime=60&amp;incremental=False&amp;sceneCode=article_draft_web&amp;animatedImageAutoPlay=False&amp;retryCount=3&amp;precoder=False" data-private-watermark-src="" data-src="https://pic-out.zhimg.com/v2-0adb59dc6af764118475322efc82fee8~resize:1440:q75.png?animatedImageAutoPlay=false&amp;animatedImagePlayCount=1&amp;auth_key=1765529419-0-0-fff970c09832d3ce19194657e916ab3d&amp;bizSceneCode=article_draft&amp;expiration=1765529419&amp;incremental=false&amp;mid=720052902642129b1b31d1be9469c826&amp;overTime=60&amp;precoder=false&amp;protocol=v2&amp;retryCount=3&amp;sampling=false&amp;sceneCode=editor_copy_outbound&amp;source=bfcaadb1" class="lazyload">
<p><strong>常规数据池</strong></p>
<p>同步规则： 由于数据特殊性，我们默认最小生成维度是测试数据，即一条用例测试数据将生成常规用例池的一条测试用例</p>
